description: Official val = Sherlock1 ses-11 run-2 (1308 words) + MOCHATIMIT ses-2 (518) [+ TheMoth ses-29 once fetched]. context-v0: Sherlock ctx 0.549 / word 0.439; MOCHA ctx 0.384 / word 0.316; zero-MEG ctx Sherlock 0.333 MOCHA 0.315. LB 0.307 tracks MOCHA, not Sherlock. Report per-task val in metrics; consider selecting on MOCHA (or macro over tasks).

title: Holdout-like local val: dense vocab spans
description: Sherlock val 0.39 predicted LB 0.22 — the ruler lacks the holdout's axis. Holdout sentences: 5-8 scored words, median gap 0.21 s, first onset 0. Build a val subset of val-run sentences whose vocab words are dense (gap stats matched to holdout) and report both. Every submission decision reads the holdout-like number.

title: Sentence-context transformer over per-word CNN embeddings
description: 3rd-party rerun: d'Ascoli CNN alone ~chance on holdout, CNN+sentence transformer 0.467. Holdout sentence rows carry every scored word's onset; group windows by sentence (epoch), encode each 1 s window with the CNN, run a transformer over the sequence with onset timing, per-word 50-way head. Train on (run, sentenceidx) groups of vocab words, chunked to <=9. Expected gain: 0.22 -> ~0.45 LB (the rerun's number). Proof: holdout-like val (dense spans) + LB.
notes: context-v0 (44 runs, 131k train words): val context BAcc@10 0.548 (n=1308, epoch-selected; plateau ~0.49-0.50), word head 0.438, dense 0.641 (n=603). cnn-v0 val 0.390. LB public: context-v0 0.30663 vs cnn-v0 0.22128 vs prior 0.200. Big val->LB gap (0.55 vs 0.31) — open question.

title: Baseline model + first real submission
description: Cheapest model that clears the prior: CNN word classifier on 1 s windows (direct 50-way CE). Submit; record LB vs local val. Gates the d'Ascoli replicate.
notes: 2026-10-01 cnn-v0 (1 s @50 Hz, demeaned, train robust-scale, 6-block dilated CNN, CE+LS0.1, 40 ep, 45,158 train windows from 22 partial runs): val BAcc@10 0.390 (n=1308 Sherlock1 ses-11 run2, best of 40 ep x 3 tau = optimistic; tau0 run 0.33) -> LB 0.22128. Not a scaling bug: scaled std val 0.876 vs holdout-sentence 0.855, same clamp rate. Matches 3rd-party: CNN alone ~chance on holdout; d'Ascoli full (sentence transformer) val 0.629 -> holdout 0.467. Holdout sentences: 5.6 scored words over ~1.2 s, median gap 0.21 s — dense, short, vocab-heavy; Sherlock val is not that distribution.

title: Submission smoke: verify live scorer before any model
description: Write the submission path (LibriBrainCompetitionHoldout -> write_submission, vocab order from pnpl vocabulary.csv incl. curly it's). Submit (a) a uniform/word-frequency prior to read the live scorer's floor. Answers: top-10 vs argmax, word rows scored?, it's spelling. Costs 1-2 of 10/day. Needs holdout only (5.7 GB), not training data.
close_reason: LB 0.20000 for constant train-frequency prior (960 rows, 114,858 heard words from 12 Sherlock events files) = exactly 10/50: LB metric is top-10 balanced acc over all 50 classes (argmax would give 0.02). CSV format, vocab order, curly it’s verified. Open: whether 92 word rows are scored and how moses cols count — not answerable by a constant row.
